source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 9.3.3 (PDF 214-215), rewritten 2026-10-27 to follow the book paragraph for paragraph.

blocks.text: Business pitch ek chhoti si presentation hai jis mein aap apna business idea samjhate hain. Farz karein aap ke paas chhote karobar ka ek achha idea hai, jaise mohalle mein nayi juice ki dukaan kholna. Business pitch mein yeh baatein hongi:

items: Idea kya hai: juice ki dukaan jo taza, sehatmand aur sasta (affordable) juice bechegi.
Customers kaun hain: mohalle ke log, khaas taur par woh jo apni sehat ka khayal rakhte hain.
Yeh kyun chalega: qareeb koi aur juice ki dukaan nahi, aur log sehat ke bare mein zyada fikr karne lage hain (health-conscious).

blocks.title: Did You Know?
blocks.text: Duniya ki kuch mashhoor tareen companies, jaise Apple aur Google, ne bhi saadi si business pitch se shuruaat ki thi. Un ke founders (bani) ko support aur investment (sarmaya) hasil karne ke liye apne ideas saaf saaf samjhane pare!

blocks.prompt: Kamyab business pitch kaisi honi chahiye (MCQ 6)?
blocks.explanation: (b) Clear and persuasive, yaani saaf aur qail karne wali.

items: Pitch mein teen baatein: idea kya hai, customers kaun hain, yeh kyun chalega.
